scope: Actual frozen two-file Core101 candidate, exact stage101 recipe and retained fake-backend test/vet/negative evidence. No application/native performance qualification.
reasoning: Initial request increment, invalid size/enum failure and sequence exhaustion retain their ordering. Early success requires the exact preceding successfully applied sequence plus exact managed raster/generation, current generation, fresh resolved pixels and packed scale. Intervening queued, failed or SetSize requests force ordinary native admission.

Fast-path mirror is under cu.mu, independent of native-only owner active/entries. Same exact window/app, atomic live composer and MainStopped guard prevent retired/stopped success; no w.Mu is acquired. MainStopped uses its own lock without callbacks or cursor-lock acquisition, so the checked lock order has no new cycle. Explicit modeSequence0/known normal/enabled/nonraw guard retains conservative fallback after mode requests.

Custom unit conversion, Get/generation work and fallback Copy remain outside cu.mu. The shortcut accepts only callback-free valid RGBA headers with zero origin, bounded dimensions/hotspot and sufficient stride/backing storage; arithmetic is bounded before multiplication/division. Invalid/custom image paths retain ordinary Copy behavior.

Only owner.apply nil publishes the mirror, carrying that actual successful seq. Publishing an older success after a newer refusal preserves actual Current behavior while the strict preceding-seq check prevents treating it as the latest admitted request. Retirement clears every mirror reference. Failure/panic/stopped paths cannot manufacture a successful mirror.

Eleven actual Cursor.Set fixture methods cover queue elision, invalidators, ordering, later refusal, stopped/closed/exhausted state, exact facade window, custom conversion, malformed raster, allocation effect, mode fallback and constructor eligibility. Baseline overlay specifically fails duplicate-queue expectation, establishing a meaningful old-source negative. Retained race regressions and vet pass; no reviewer rerun.

Prepared stage101 input hashes match current100 C cursor source and absent new test; isolated reproduction vector changes only cursor.go and adds the new test. Original native owner/pointer/generation/queue support remains byte-identical. Root still owns full integration/preparation and checkpoint review.
limitations: Race/vet/negative evidence is software fake-backend evidence from native-linked test binaries, not physical cursor or actual native workload evidence.
Permanent fallback after any explicit mode request is a conservative scope limit; broader mode reuse is not claimed.
Fresh actual post101 native comparison is required; the source100 approximately65ms p95/60Hz failure remains open.
